title: Bank statement line v1
description: One credit on a bank statement, as accepted by POST /api/v1/statements (a JSON array of lines). Owned by aws-reconciliation-engine.

line_id.description: Unique per statement line; the idempotency key of ingestion.

bank_txn_id.description: The bank's transaction id; equal ids mean the same payment.

counterparty_account.description: The payee account the cash arrived on.

reference.description: Remittance reference; a settlement_id when the payer quoted one.
